title: 第90章 八阵八卦
content_zh:
厉宏生上前三步说：“易姑娘的八极拳果然神妙，我领教领教你的八卦掌！”说着踏步进亭。

易点点见他步履凝稳，知是劲敌。本来凡练游身八卦掌之人，必然步法珙逸，行路犹如足不点地一般，但他脚步落地极重，尘土飞扬，那是自重至轻、至轻返重，根基坚实无比，他数十年的功力，决非自己能望其项背。

闵嘉庚快步走到亭中，拿起茶杯喝了一口，低声说：“此人厉害，不可轻敌。”易点点眼皮低垂，细声问：“我多次坏你大事，你不怪我么？”这句话闵嘉庚却答不上来。说不怪吧，可是她接连三次将朱金亚从自己手底下救出；说怪吧，瞧着她若有情若无情的眼波，却又怎能怪得？

易点点见闵嘉庚走入亭来叫自己提防，芳心大慰，她本来心下担忧，生怕斗不过这位万澜高手，这时精神一振，低声说：“我心里好对你不起！我如不行，请你帮我照看着！”依她原来好胜的性子，这句话明显服软，无论如何是不肯说的，但今晚又坏了他的大事，心下甚歉，说这句话，是有意跟他说和修好。

她足尖一蹬，跃上一张圆凳，说道：“厉老师，万澜八卦掌功夫讲究足踏八卦方位，乾、坤、巽、坎、震、兑、离、艮，咱们便在这些凳上过过招。”厉宏生说：“好！”慢慢踏上圆凳，双手互捶，一掌领前，一掌居后。闵嘉庚又向易点点瞧了一眼，退出亭子。

易点点说：“素闻万澜厉氏兄弟齐名，待会宏生老师败了之后，宏明老师还打不打呢？”厉宏生生性凝重，听了这话却也忍不住气往上冲，依她说来，似乎还没动手，自己已经败定。他本就不善言辞，盛怒之下，更结结巴巴地说不出话。

厉宏明怒道：“小丫头胡说八道，你只须在我大哥手下接得一百招，咱兄弟俩从此不使八卦掌！”厉氏兄弟望重武林，寻常武师连他们的十招八招也接不住。厉宏明出口竟说到一百招，只因见到她打败包金朋，已丝毫没小觑了她。

易点点斜眼相睨，冷冷说：“我打败令兄之后，算不算万澜集团掌舵？你还打不打？”厉宏明说：“你先吹什么？打得赢我哥哥再说不迟。”易点点说：“我要先问个明白。”

厉宏明尚未答话，厉宏生问：“尊师是谁？”易点点问：“你问我师承干嘛？”她乌溜溜的眼珠骨碌一转，已明其意，说道：“嗯，宏生老师动了真怒，要下杀手，因此先问一问我师父。我师父名头太响，说出来吓坏了你。我不抬师父出来。你尽管使你的万澜绝招。常言道不知者不罪，你便打死了我，我师父也不能怪你。”

这几句话正说中了厉宏生心事，他见易点点先和闵嘉庚相斗，跟着制住包金朋，出手着实不俗，定然大有来头，如下重手伤了她，她师父日后找场，多半极难应付，听她这般说，便说：“这里各位都是见证。”呼的一掌迎面击出，掌力未施，身随掌起，踏坤奔离，足下方位已移。别瞧他身躯肥大，一使出轻功，竟如飞燕掠波。

易点点斜掌卸力，自艮追震，手上使的固是八卦掌，脚下踏的也全是八卦方位。厉宏生连劈数掌，都为她一一卸开。两人绕着圆桌，在十二只石凳上奔驰旋转，倒似小儿捉迷藏一般，但越转越快，衣襟生风。

厉宏生心想：“这丫头心思灵巧，诱我在石凳上跟她隔桌换掌。她掌力原本不能跟我相比，但中间挡着一张圆桌，有了间距，便不怕我沉猛的掌力了。”又想：“这丫头武功甚杂，居然将八卦掌使得头头是道，我何必用寻常掌法跟她纠缠？”猛地里一声长啸，脚步错乱，手掌歪斜，混着威风激穿拳和荣光之爪，竟使出了他的家传绝技八阵八卦掌来。

这一路功夫厉士玉只传两个儿子，不传外姓弟子，那是在八卦掌中夹了八阵图之法：天阵居乾为天门，地阵居坤为地门，风阵居巽为风门，云阵居震为云门，飞龙居坎为飞龙门，虎翼居兑为虎翼门，鸟翔居离为鸟翔门，蛇盘居艮为蛇盘门；天地风云为四正门，龙虎鸟蛇为四奇门；乾坤艮巽为阖门，坎离震兑为开门。这四正四奇，四开四阖，用到武学之上，霎时间变化奇幻，虽在小小凉亭中，隐隐有布阵而战之意。

这八阵八卦掌易点点别说没学过，连听也没听过，只因这是厉士玉的不传之秘，以她师父武学之博，却也有所未知。易点点只接得数掌，顿时眼花缭乱，暗暗叫苦。

闵嘉庚站在亭外掠阵，随即看出情势不妙，但易点点大言在先，说要夺万澜掌舵之位，自己决不能插手相助，眼见厉宏生越打越占上风，正没做理会处，忽见易点点左足一蹬，跃上桌面说：“凳子上施展不开，咱们在桌上斗斗。厉老师，可不许踏碎了茶碗果碟。”厉宏生一言不发，跟着上了桌面，这时两人相距近了，易点点无可取巧，对方攻过来的拳掌势须硬接硬架，但脚下却占了便宜。桌上放着十二只茶碗，四盘果子，全是散落乱置，这可不同梅花桩、青竹阵每一处落足点均有规律，厉宏生的八阵八卦掌在平地上施展威力最强，一上梅花桩，变化既受限制，威力便已相应减弱。这时在桌面上更生怕不小心踏碎了茶碗果盘，为这刁钻的丫头所笑，便尽量不移脚步，一味催动掌力，自忖不凭步法之妙，单靠深厚内功，就能将她毁在一双肉掌之下。

但听掌风呼呼，亭畔的花朵为他掌力所激，片片落英，飞舞而下。

当易点点跃上桌面时早已计及利害，见对方一掌掌如疾风骤雨般击到，她足不停步地前蹿后跃，并不和他对掌拆解，情知只消和对方雄浑的掌力一站，便脱不了身，见厉宏生右掌虚晃，左掌斜引，右掌正要劈出，她左足尖轻轻一挑，一只茶碗向他扑面飞去。厉宏生吃了一惊，闪身避开，易点点料到他趋避的方位，双足连挑，七八只茶碗接二连三地飞过去。厉宏生避开了三只，终于避不开第四五只，啪啪两声，打中了他肩头。他出掌劈开第七八只，碗中的茶水茶叶却淋了他满头满脸，跟着第九十只茶碗又击中胸口。

厉氏兄弟齐声怒吼，旁观的党国旺、葛大林、李云等也忍不住惊呼，只见最后两只茶碗直奔厉宏生双眼。他愤怒已极，猛力发掌击出。易点点脚踢茶碗，其志不在以茶碗击敌，早就一直在等他这掌，这良机如何肯错过？身躯一闪，已伸手抓住他右腕，左手在他臂弯里“曲池穴”一拿，一扭一推，喀的一响，厉宏明大叫啊哟声中，厉宏生臂骱已脱。

这一手仍是寻常的分筋错骨手，说不上是什么奇妙家数，只她在茶碗纷飞中出手如电，钻了巧妙空子，厉宏生竟不及留神，闪避不了，致贻终身之羞。

厉宏明双手一拍，和身向易点点背后扑去。闵嘉庚推出右掌，将他震退三步，说道：“前辈且慢！说好是一个斗一个。”

厉宏生面色惨白，僵在桌上。易点点心想：“如轻易放了他，他兄弟回头找场，我可斗他们不过！”竟下手不容情，趁他无力抗御之时，喀喇一声，将他左臂的关节也卸脱了，一指点在他“太阳穴”上，喝问：“万澜掌舵之位让是不让？”

厉宏生闭目待死，更不说话。厉宏明见兄长命悬敌手，喝道：“快放开我大哥！你要做万澜掌舵，做你的便是。”易点点说：“说话可要算数？”厉宏明说：“算数，算数！”易点点这才微微一笑，跃下桌子。厉宏明背起兄长，头也不回地快步走出。
content_en:
Li Hongsheng took three steps forward and said, "Ms. Yi's Bajiquan is really amazing. I'll learn about your Bajiazhang!" He then stepped into the pavilion.

Yi Diandian saw his steady steps and knew he was a powerful enemy.Originally, anyone who practiced Swimming Baguazhang would definitely have smooth and graceful steps, as if he were not touching the ground. However, his steps were extremely heavy and dusty. It was from lightness to lightness and then back to heavyness. His foundation was extremely solid. His decades of skill could not be matched by his own.

Min Jiageng walked quickly to the pavilion, picked up the tea cup, took a sip, and whispered: "This person is very powerful, so don't underestimate him." Yi Diandian lowered his eyelids and asked in a low voice: "I have ruined your important things many times, don't you blame me?" But Min Jiageng couldn't answer this question.It's not strange, but she rescued Zhu Jinya from her hands three times in a row; it's strange, looking at her eyes that were both affectionate and ruthless, how could it be surprising?

Yi Diandian was greatly relieved when she saw Min Jiageng walking into the pavilion and telling her to be on guard. She was originally worried, fearing that she would not be able to defeat this master of Wanlan, but then she became energetic and whispered: "I feel so sorry for you! If I can't,Please take care of it for me!" According to her original competitive nature, this sentence was obviously subdued and she would not say it anyway, but she ruined his important event tonight, and she felt very sorry. She said this with the intention of trying to reconcile with him.

She kicked off her toes, jumped up on a round stool, and said, "Teacher Li, Wanlan Baguazhang Kung Fu pays attention to the directions of the eight trigrams, Qian, Kun, Xun, Kan, Zhen, Dui, Li, Gen. We have practiced on these stools." Li Hongsheng said, "Okay!" He slowly stepped onto the round stool and beat each other with his hands, one palm leading the front and the other behind.Min Jiageng glanced at Yi Dian again and exited the pavilion.

Yi Diandian said: "We have heard that the Wanlan Li brothers are equally famous. After Teacher Hongsheng is defeated, will Teacher Hongming still fight?" Li Hongsheng has a dignified nature, but after hearing this, he couldn't help but get angry. According to her, it seemed that he had already been defeated before he took action.He was not good at words, and when he was so angry, he even stammered and couldn't speak.

Li Hongming said angrily: "Little girl, you are talking nonsense. You only need to receive a hundred moves from my elder brother, and we two brothers will never use Baguazhang from now on!" The Li brothers respected the martial arts, and ordinary martial arts masters could not even catch their ten or eight moves.Li Hongming actually mentioned a hundred moves, just because he saw her defeat Bao Jinpeng, he didn't underestimate her at all.

Yi Diandian looked at each other sideways and said coldly: "After I defeat brother Ling, do I count as the helm of the Wanlan Group? Do you want to fight?" Li Hongming said, "What are you bragging about first? It won't be too late until I beat my brother." Yi Diandian said, "I want to ask for clarification first."

Before Li Hongming could answer, Li Hongsheng asked: "Who is your respected teacher?" Yi Diandian asked: "Why are you asking about my teacher's inheritance?" She rolled her dark eyes and understood what she meant, and said: "Well, Teacher Hongsheng is really angry and wants to kill him., so ask my master first.My master's name is too famous, and I will scare you.Even if you use your Wanlan trick, you can beat me to death, and my master can't blame you."

These words hit the mark on Li Hongsheng's mind. When he saw Yi Diandian fighting with Min Jiageng, and then restraining Bao Jinpeng, his move was really good and must have a lot of background. If he hurt her with a heavy hand like this, her master's dayAfter looking for a scene, it was probably extremely difficult to deal with it. After hearing what she said, he said: "Everyone here is a witness." He struck out with a palm, but without applying the force of the palm, he rose up with the palm and ran away, and the position under his feet had moved.Despite his fat body, when he uses Qing Gong, he is like a flying swallow grazing the waves.

Yi Diandian slanted his palms to release the force, and he was shaking from the ground. The hands he used were Bagua Zhang, and the feet he stepped on were all Bagua directions.Li Hongsheng took off several blows for her one by one.The two of them circled the round table and spun around on the twelve stone benches, just like children playing hide-and-seek, but they spun faster and faster, and the wind blew in their clothes.

Li Hongsheng thought to himself: "This girl is very clever and tricked me into switching palms with her on the stone bench across the table. Her palm power was originally not comparable to mine, but there was a round table in the middle. With the gap, she was no longer afraid of my heavy palm power." He thought again: "This girl's martial arts skills are very good.Za, she actually used Baguazhang to be so clear-headed, why should I use ordinary palm techniques to tangle with her?" There was a sudden roar, his steps were disordered, his palms were skewed, and he actually used his family's unique skill, Eight Formations of Baguazhang, mixed with the Powerful Penetration Fist and the Glory Claw.

Li Shiyu only passed down this kung fu to his two sons and not to his disciples with other surnames. It was based on the method of eight formation diagrams sandwiched in the Baguazhang: the Heaven Formation is located in Qian as Tianmen, the Earth Formation is located in Kun as Earth Gate, the Wind Formation is located in Xun as Fengmen, and the Cloud Formation is located in Zhen as Yunmen.Feilongjukan is called Feilongmen, Tigerwing Judui is called Tigerwing Gate, Bird Xiangjuli is called Birdxiangmen, and Snake Panjugen is called Snakepanmen; Heaven and earth, wind and cloud are the four main gates, dragon, tiger, bird and snake are the four strange gates; Qiankun, Genxun is the closed door, and Kanli Zhendui is the open door.These four upright and four strange, four open and four closed, are used in martial arts, and the changes are magical in an instant. Although it is in a small pavilion, there is a vague intention of setting up a battle formation.

Not only have I never learned these eight formations of Ba Gua Zhang, I have never even heard of them. This is because this is Li Shiyu’s undisclosed secret. Even with her master’s vast knowledge of martial arts, she still doesn’t know anything about it.Yi Diandian could only receive a few palms, and was suddenly dizzy and groaned secretly.

Min Jiageng stood outside the pavilion and immediately saw that the situation was not good, but Yi Diandian made a big statement first, saying that he wanted to seize Wan Lan's position at the helm, and he would never intervene to help. Seeing that Li Hongsheng was getting the upper hand, he was not paying attention to it, but suddenly Yi Diandian kicked off his left foot, jumped up on the table and said: "StoolWe can't use it on the table, so let's fight on the table.Teacher Li, please don't break the tea bowl and fruit plate." Without saying a word, Li Hongsheng followed up on the table. At this time, the two of them were close to each other. Yi Diandian had no choice. The opponent's punches and palms had to be counterattacked, but he took advantage of it.There are twelve tea bowls and four plates of fruits on the table, all scattered and disorderly. This is different from the plum blossom pile and the green bamboo formation where every foothold is regular. Li Hongsheng's eight formations of Baguazhang are most powerful on the flat ground. Once on the plum blossom pile, the changes are restricted and the power is weakened accordingly.At this time, she was even more worried about accidentally stepping on the tea bowl and fruit plate on the table. She was laughed at by this tricky girl, so she tried not to move her steps and just used her palm power, thinking that she could be destroyed by a pair of fleshy palms instead of relying on the wonderful footwork and only relying on her deep internal strength.

But listening to the wind blowing in his palm, the flowers beside the pavilion were stirred by the power of his palm, and pieces of them fell, flying down.

When Yi Diandian jumped onto the table, she had already considered the dangers. Seeing that the opponent's palm struck like a gust of wind, she kept jumping forward and back without stopping, not dismantling his palms. She knew that she could not get away as long as she stood against the opponent's powerful palm. When she saw Li Hongsheng's right palm feinting, his left palm slanted, and his right palm was about to strike out, she lifted her left toe lightly, and a tea bowl flew towards him.Li Hongsheng was startled and ducked out of the way. Yi Diandian guessed the direction he was trying to avoid. He raised his feet and seven or eight tea bowls flew over one after another.Li Hongsheng avoided three, but finally couldn't avoid the fourth and fifth, which hit him on the shoulder twice.He opened the seventh or eighth teacup with his palm, but the tea in the bowl splashed all over his head and face, and then the ninetieth teacup hit his chest again.

The Li brothers roared in unison, and Dang Guowang, Ge Dalin, Li Yun and others who were watching couldn't help but exclaimed, and saw the last two tea bowls going straight into Li Hongsheng's eyes.He was extremely angry and struck out with his palm.Yi Diandian kicked the tea bowl. His intention was not to use the tea bowl to attack the enemy. He had been waiting for his palm for a long time. How could he miss this opportunity?As soon as his body flashed, he reached out to grab his right wrist, and used his left hand to grab the "Quchi point" in his arm. He twisted and pushed, and with a click, Li Hongming screamed, and Li Hongsheng's arm was taken off.

This hand was still an ordinary hand that split muscles and bones, and it couldn't be said to be a magical skill. However, she moved like lightning amidst the flying tea bowls and took advantage of clever loopholes. Li Hongsheng didn't pay attention in time and was unable to dodge, causing him lifelong shame.

Li Hongming clapped his hands and rushed towards Yi Diandian's back.Min Jiageng pushed out his right palm, knocked him back three steps, and said: "Senior, wait a minute! We agreed to fight one by one."

Li Hongsheng looked pale and froze on the table.Yi Diandian thought to himself: "If I let him go easily, his brothers will come back to find trouble, and I can't fight them!" He was merciless, and when he was unable to resist, he detached the joints of his left arm with a click, pointed a finger at his "temple", and asked: "Are you going to give up the position of Wan Lan at the helm?"

Li Hongsheng closed his eyes and waited for death, not to mention saying a word.Seeing that his brother's life was hanging by the enemy's hand, Li Hongming shouted: "Let go of my brother! You want to be the helmsman of Wanlan, and it's your job." Yi Diandian said, "Do you have to keep your words?" Li Hongming said, "Count, keep!" Yi Diandian then smiled slightly and jumped off the table.Li Hongming carried his brother on his back and walked out quickly without looking back.
title_en: Chapter 90 Eight Formations and Eight Trigrams
